findings.highlight: I walk to the train station for twenty minutes.
findings.evidenceJa: 駅前から歩くこと二十分
findings.governingReading: 駅前から is the starting point of the twenty-minute walk to the church.
findings.explanation: Walking from the station becomes walking to it.

findings.governingReading: 木刀 is a wooden practice sword, distinct from its shinai bag.
findings.explanation: Wooden swords repeatedly become bamboo swords.
